description: The benchmark that put Marlborough on the world's wine map, and still a model of the style. Ripe honeydew melon, passionfruit and citrus play against a cool thread of blackcurrant leaf; fermented largely in stainless steel with a whisper of old French oak, it stays concentrated yet bright, closing on a saline, sea-air freshness.
sommelierNotes: Serve well-chilled as an apéritif, or alongside fresh goat cheese, oysters, ceviche, and green-herb salads.
aroma: Honeydew melon, passionfruit, citrus and a touch of blackcurrant leaf
palate: Concentrated and elegant, tropical fruit cut by makrut lime and grapefruit
finish: Lemongrass and a saline, sea-air lift
